statements.t: “As homes took longer to sell, we adjusted our acquisition criteria to require higher expected returns and became more selective about new purchases, while serving more sellers through Cash Offer Marketplace and Brokerage Services.
“Together, we expect those actions to continue to support liquidity and lower the transaction volume required to reach Adjusted EBITDA breakeven.”

Offerpad’s ability to successfully launch, market to customers, manage or expand its products and services

the success of strategic relationships with third parties
Offerpad’s transfer to The Nasdaq Stock Market LLC and ability to meet continued listing standards
macroeconomic trends, including due to conflict in the Middle East
Offerpad’s ability to use net operating loss carryforwards and other tax attributes due to ownership changes
